info.description: This template searches for missing HTTP security headers. The impact of these missing headers can vary.

request:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: ldap-api:8000
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/90.0.4430.93 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Length: 22
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
Content-Type: application/json
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp
Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 23:43:45 GMT
Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
Server: uvicorn
Vary: Origin
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
X-Frame-Options: DENY
X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none

{"detail":"Not Found"}
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/90.0.4430.93 Safari/537.36' 'http://ldap-api:8000'
